subcategory_text: Identify and integrate toolchains that automate security testing, code analysis, build, and deployment to reduce the risk of human error and increase the efficiency of security activities.
informative_references: NIST SP 800-53 Rev. 5: SA-15, SA-11, CM-7
implementation_examples: Integrate SAST, DAST, SCA, secret scanning, and IaC scanning tools into CI/CD
Pin tool versions and verify integrity of tools in the toolchain
Maintain a toolchain inventory with supported versions and update cadence
assessment_objectives: Determine whether toolchains automate security testing and analysis.
Determine whether toolchain components are inventoried and their integrity verified.
